review.notes: H3 video. The three-barrel gun fired where it should not: the first idle flashed and smoked, the ram attack shot flame and the ranged burst lit the whole body. The idle was retaken from one reference with the barrels tipped down and comes back clean; it skips its rejected plates and joins frames 56 and 90. The attack keeps the first take and skips the flame frames, snapping from the drawn-back gun to full reach; a clubbing retake was tried but lost most of its plates. The ranged retake still flashed on one frame, so it holds the aim, skips the flash and recoil frames, and drops the gun as the recoil before returning to the hip. The cast skips three frames with plate smudges. The walk loops on frames 31 to 91.
